description: Structural material properties used by frame stress checks. All values are sourced and carry an explicit uncertainty; a component check that needs a material not listed here must have that material added with a source, or the check must fail closed (report 'unknown property', not 'pass').

materials.name: Aluminum 6061-T6
materials.notes: Common for machined motor mounts and booms.
materials.source: ASM Metals Handbook / MatWeb standard published values (T6 temper)

materials.name: Quasi-isotropic CFRP laminate (epoxy)
materials.notes: Layup-dependent: values represent a typical [0/45/-45/90]s carbon/epoxy laminate. 'yield' is approximate (composites do not yield like metals); used as the allowable strength for frame checks.
materials.source: Typical quasi-isotropic laminate properties, Composite Materials Handbook series / manufacturer laminate data sheets

materials.name: Nylon PA12 (SLS / MJF print)
materials.notes: Common for printed motor mounts and camera plates; sensitive to moisture and temperature.
materials.source: Typical PA12 powder-bed fusion material datasheets (e.g., HP MJF PA12, EOS PA2200)

materials.name: PLA (FDM print)
materials.notes: Prototype-grade; print orientation and infill strongly affect strength (uncertainty does not cover layer-adhesion knockdowns — flag as 'needs print-specific test data' for load-bearing parts).
materials.source: Typical published PLA tensile properties (e.g., MatWeb generic PLA, manufacturer datasheets)
